resources.string: Live AI advice · voice coach must be on

Optional. Anthropic receives activity summaries, splits and estimated laps, including self-reported effort and routine type. Titles and notes are sent only if selected; raw GPS points and photos are never sent. Requests use your paid API credits. Live advice runs every few minutes, up to 24 requests per activity. Automatic reviews and plan updates are separate options. Your key is encrypted on this phone.
Key saved. Leave empty to keep it.
Stored encrypted on this phone only.
Haiku: claude-haiku-5-5 · Sonnet: claude-sonnet-5-5. You can enter another supported Claude model ID.
Connected. Model access confirmed; no generation was requested.
Key removed. AI features are off.
Use valid Claude model IDs and an interval from 3 to 10 minutes.

Check your Anthropic key and account access.

Thinking… You can close this screen; the result is saved when ready.
Ask Claude to review this activity and recent summaries. This uses API credits. GPS and elevation are estimates; advice is not a medical assessment.
Set your goal and usual weekly distance. Start with a local plan, then optionally personalize it with Claude. Plans are suggestions: adjust for recovery, discomfort and real life.
Choose 1–50 km, a date 4–52 weeks away, 2–5 days per week and a current weekly distance of 5–100 km.
This replaces the schedule and its checkmarks. Your saved activities remain.
Local plan saved. Personalize with Claude when ready.
Plan updated. Past sessions were preserved.
Personalized with Claude. Automatic updates, if enabled, run at most once a day when you open the app or finish an activity.
Local plan · no API request. Missed sessions are not stacked onto another day.
